# UI Design Ecosystem

> A catalogue of domain-specific UI/UX design systems, packaged as installable
> skills for Claude, Gemini and GPT. Each pack carries a thesis another domain
> would reject, plus the tokens, measurements and reasoning to act on it. Users
> install the one pack that fits their project.

Structure: `core/` holds rules true for every interface and never holds a
concrete value; `packs/<id>/` holds what one domain decided and never repeats a
core rule; `dist/` is generated from both, one build per assistant format.

If you are an agent installing a pack for a user, read INSTALL.md first — it has
the selection procedure, and picking the wrong pack is worse than picking none.

## Start here

- [INSTALL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/INSTALL.md): selection and install guide written for AI agents. Step 1 is identifying the project type; do not skip it.
- [dist/index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/dist/index.json): machine-readable catalogue. Every pack with its `when` and `notFor` signals, keywords, and install paths.

## Packs

<!-- PACKS:START:llms -->
- [consumer-web](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/dist/gemini/consumer-web.GEMINI.md): Consumer web (beta). Public-facing sites read by strangers: marketing pages, landing pages, product sites, documentation and editorial. NOT for internal tools, admin panels and operations consoles - use the erp pack, which is built for the opposite reader.
- [erp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/dist/gemini/erp.GEMINI.md): ERP & back-office (stable). Dense, dark-chrome operational software: admin panels, operations consoles, back-office tools, internal dashboards. NOT for marketing sites, landing pages or anything optimised for a first impression.
- [immersive-web](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/dist/gemini/immersive-web.GEMINI.md): Immersive web (draft). Public pages built around one real-time 3D scene the visitor can drive: product viewers and configurators, a 3D hero for a company site, a spatial subject taught in the browser - with three.js, React Three Fiber or model-viewer. NOT for a marketing or landing page with no real-time scene - use the consumer-web pack, whose JavaScript budget this pack spends several times over.
- [mobile-app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/dist/gemini/mobile-app.GEMINI.md): Mobile app (beta). Installed apps held in one hand: iOS and Android, native or cross-platform, used in short interrupted sessions. NOT for desktop admin panels, operations consoles and anything used with a mouse at desk distance - use the erp pack.
<!-- PACKS:END:llms -->

## Core — applies whatever you are building

- [01-tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/core/references/01-tokens.md): token systems. Every accent needs one value per surface; no raw hex outside the token file.
- [02-typography](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/core/references/02-typography.md): scale construction, rem vs em, measure, tabular numerals.
- [03-layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/core/references/03-layout.md): grid and flex traps, responsive method, restoring state before first paint.
- [04-motion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/core/references/04-motion.md): duration bands by repetition count, and honouring reduced motion correctly.
- [05-accessibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/core/references/05-accessibility.md): focus, keyboard, landmarks, contrast, colour-not-alone.
- [06-i18n](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/core/references/06-i18n.md): marking strings, width headroom, locale formatting, RTL readiness.
- [07-charts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/core/references/07-charts.md): honest axes, degenerate cases, hit testing, the table fallback.
- [08-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/core/references/08-review.md): the universal checklist and the failure modes that recur everywhere.

## Optional

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): why core and overlay, why dist is generated, and which decisions are still open.
- [docs/AUTHORING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/docs/AUTHORING.md): how to add a pack. A pack needs a thesis another domain would reject.
- [docs/RESEARCH.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/docs/RESEARCH.md): where the evidence for a rule comes from - which sources are worth a pack author's time, which mislead, and four case studies.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DMonkey0908/ui-design-ecosystem/main/README.md): human-facing overview.
